claims.text: What the image looks like Tracheal deviation TOWARD white-out → atelectasis / pneumonectomy / mucous plug
claims.quote: Tracheal deviation TOWARD white-out Atelectasis / pneumonectomy / mucous plug
claims.locator: Chest X-Ray (CXR), Air / Fluid in Pleural Space table

claims.text: Aspects (abnormal in red) Airway: trachea midline
claims.quote: A - Airway: trachea midline; carina; ETT tip ~4 cm above carina.
claims.locator: Chest X-Ray (CXR), Reading Approach (RIPE technical adequacy → ABCDE-FGHI)

claims.text: Clinically significant atelectasis is generally visible on chest radiographs; findings can include localized lung opacification and/or loss of lung volume; milder cases may only be seen on chest CT
claims.quote: Atelectasis that is clinically significant (eg, that causes symptoms, increases risk of complications, or meaningfully affects pulmonary function) is generally visible on chest radiographs; findings can include localized lung opacification and/or loss of lung volume. More mild cases may not be apparent on chest radiographs and can only be seen with cross-sectional imaging (ie chest CT).

claims.text: Example: collapse of all lobes of the left lung due to a mucus plug
claims.quote: This chest radiograph shows collapse of all lobes of the left lung due to a mucus plug.

claims.text: Causes Reversible collapse of lung tissue with loss of volume; common causes: intrinsic or extrinsic airway compression, hypoventilation and a malpositioned endotracheal tube
claims.quote: Atelectasis is reversible collapse of lung tissue with loss of volume; common causes include intrinsic or extrinsic airway compression, hypoventilation, and a malpositioned endotracheal tube.

claims.text: Intrinsic airway obstruction: foreign body, tumor, mucous plug
claims.quote: Intrinsic obstruction of airways (eg, by foreign body, tumor, mucous plug)

claims.text: Thoracic and abdominal surgeries are very common causes (general anesthesia, opioid use with possible respiratory depression, often painful respiration); a malpositioned endotracheal tube can occlude a mainstem bronchus
claims.quote: Thoracic and abdominal surgeries are very common causes because they involve general anesthesia, opioid use (with possible secondary respiratory depression), and often painful respiration. A malpositioned endotracheal tube can cause atelectasis by occluding a mainstem bronchus.

claims.text: Symptoms Usually asymptomatic, but hypoxemia and pleuritic chest pain may be present; dyspnea or respiratory failure if extensive; pneumonia may develop
claims.quote: Patients may have dyspnea or respiratory failure if atelectasis is extensive. They may also develop pneumonia. Atelectasis is usually asymptomatic, but hypoxemia and pleuritic chest pain may be present.

claims.text: Signs are often absent if minimal; if large: decreased breath sounds over the area, and possibly dullness to percussion and decreased chest excursion
claims.quote: Signs are often absent if atelectasis is minimal. Decreased breath sounds in the region of atelectasis and possibly dullness to percussion and decreased chest excursion are detectable if the area of atelectasis is large.

claims.text: Treatment and next step Her chart: bronchoscopy / re-expansion
claims.locator: Chest X-Ray (CXR), Air / Fluid in Pleural Space table

claims.text: Incentive spirometry, maximal coughing, deep breathing and, whenever possible, mobilization
claims.quote: Treatment involves using incentive spirometry, maximizing coughing, deep breathing, and, whenever possible, encouraging mobilization.

claims.text: Most importantly, treat the underlying cause (eg, mucous plug, foreign body, tumor, mass, pulmonary effusion)
claims.quote: Most importantly, the underlying cause of atelectasis (eg, mucous plug, foreign body, tumor, mass, pulmonary effusion) should be treated.

claims.text: Persistent mucous plugging: nebulized dornase alfa and sometimes bronchodilators are tried
claims.quote: For persistent mucous plugging, nebulized dornase alfa (which breaks down DNA in mucus) and sometimes bronchodilators are tried

claims.text: Bronchoscopy if other measures fail or an obstruction other than mucous plugging is suspected
claims.quote: If other measures are ineffective or if a cause of obstruction other than mucous plugging is suspected, bronchoscopy should be performed.
